description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Template', which is a core part of the Smarty templating engine. It manages template data structures, rendering, caching, inheritance, and plugin handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Template
classes.description: Main class handling template data, rendering, and cache management within the Smarty engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Smarty_Internal_Template object with given parameters, loading the source resource, and setting up cache and compilation configurations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template, handling cache, compilation, output filtering, and debugging features.

methods.name: _subTemplateRender
methods.description: Runtime method to render a sub-template with specific parameters, managing cache objects, variables, and debug info.

methods.name: _subTemplateRegister
methods.description: Registers sub-templates used within the template for tracking.

methods.name: _isSubTpl
methods.description: Checks if the current template is a sub-template by verifying parent relationships.

methods.name: _assignInScope
methods.description: Assigns a variable into a specific scope within the template execution context.

methods.name: _checkPlugins
methods.description: Verifies that required plugins are callable or includes their files if needed.

methods.name: _decodeProperties
methods.description: Decodes properties from compiled or cache files, validating timestamps and integrity.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Triggers compilation of the template source if necessary.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes content to the cache resource.

methods.name: _getTemplateId
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the unique ID for the template.

methods.name: capture_error
methods.description: Handles errors in template capture blocks.

methods.name: loadCompiled
methods.description: Loads the compiled version of the template, with an option to force reload.

methods.name: loadCached
methods.description: Loads the cached version of the template, with an option to force reload.

methods.name: _loadInheritance
methods.description: Initializes inheritance data structures.

methods.name: _cleanUp
methods.description: Resets internal state, callbacks, and inheritance object.

methods.name: loadCompiler
methods.description: Loads the template's compiler class and initializes it.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, directing them to Smarty or parent class.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Accesses Smarty properties or internal template data.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets Smarty properties or internal template data.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor to release cache lock if needed.
